name: Druid of Hungwood
source:
The village of Hungwood is under attack!  But where are all the heroes?  An evil knight has imprisoned them all, allowing enemies to wreak havoc!

It's up to the merchant/leaf-caster Rodin to form a group of NPCs formidable enough to rescue the heroes and save Hungwood!

But it's not all work and no play!  Many enemies would rather have fun than fight, and taking a more friendly approach can turn enemies to your side without having to kill them!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3912280/Druid_of_Hungwood/]Steam[/url]]
